description.value: Papa John's is a national pizza chain located on 6th Avenue in New Westminster offering delivery and carryout. The menu includes pizza, breadsticks, and wings, with vegetarian and gluten-free options available. A touring cyclist looking for a hot meal or a quick carryout stop in New Westminster would find this a convenient option along the route.
